name: Machinist V-Block
description: 60 x 40 x 40 mm machinist V-block: 90-degree V-groove 16 mm deep, side clamp grooves, and a base relief channel.

steps.instruction: Create the block: 60 mm wide (X), 40 mm deep (Y) and 40 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the block: 60 mm wide (X), 40 mm deep (Y) and 40 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the solid 60 x 40 x 40 mm block the V-block is machined from.

steps.instruction: Cut the 90-degree V-groove along Y through the top face: subtract a square prism of side 28.2843 mm, rotated 45 degrees about the Y axis, centered at (0, 0, 44) — the groove comes out 16 mm deep and 32 mm wide at the top.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut the 90-degree V-groove along Y through the top face: subtract a square prism of side 28.2843 mm, rotated 45 degrees about the Y axis, centered at (0, 0, 44) — the groove comes out 16 mm deep and 32 mm wide at the top.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the 90-degree V down the length of the block — 16 mm deep with a 32 mm opening, ready to cradle round stock.

steps.instruction: Cut a clamp groove into each side face: rectangular slots 8 mm tall (Z=16 to Z=24) and 3 mm deep, running the full depth in Y, on the faces at X = +/-30.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut a clamp groove into each side face: rectangular slots 8 mm tall (Z=16 to Z=24) and 3 mm deep, running the full depth in Y, on the faces at X = +/-30.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the clamp grooves into both flanks — an 8 mm band, 3 mm deep, for the V-block clamp fingers to grip.

steps.instruction: Cut a relief channel into the base: 20 mm wide (X), 4 mm deep, running the full depth in Y, centered in X.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut a relief channel into the base: 20 mm wide (X), 4 mm deep, running the full depth in Y, centered in X.
transcript.assistant_message: I relieved the base with a 20 mm wide channel so the block seats on two rails instead of one broad face.

steps.instruction: Chamfer the straight edges of the top face (including the V rim) with a 1 mm chamfer.

transcript.user_prompt: Chamfer the straight edges of the top face (including the V rim) with a 1 mm chamfer.
transcript.assistant_message: I chamfered the top edges and the V rim 1 mm — no burr-prone sharp corners remain on the working face.
